title: GTB Tab Stats
description: A mod that adds Hypixel Guess The Build statistics in the tablist.
body:
A Minecraft fabric mod for the hypixel server that displays guess the build-related information (selected language, GTB wins, Build Battle score) in the tab list when in a guess the build lobby.

This does not check that you're actually in hypixel or a guess the build lobby, it is recommended to only use it in hypixel.

This mod performs request to my server which handles some caching and keeps the Hypixel API token.
